note: Superior National Forest (LaCroix district) campground on the south shore of 1,222-acre Echo Lake, at the west end of the Echo Trail about 22 miles northeast of Orr. Gravel back-in sites on loops under aspen, spruce and pine; heavy vegetation limits the lake view from many sites, with trails down to the water. Boat ramp with dock, sandy swimming beach, picnic area and playground. Three free boat-in dispersed sites on the lake are separate. No ATVs. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 232000 read: 22 sites (12 standard + group reservable, 9 FCFS; RV/trailer to 45 ft back-in gravel), $18 / group $30 (2027-28 same), nonelectric, vault toilets + solar water (off Oct-Nov), 5-day cutoff, 14 nights, 9 people, second vehicle $9. Lakeview kept. Manual season May 8-Sep 26 matches the FS page; rec.gov sells first-come nights to Oct 19 (flag). Phone missing.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept. FS/rec.gov: 'Heavy vegetation may limit the lake view from some sites; however, there are numerous trails leading to the water'. On imagery every site is under continuous canopy; the nearest to the shore is 016 (48.17112,-92.49121), about 25-30 m from the water through forest, then 017 (48.17100,-92.49157) and 014 (48.17091,-92.49091) at about 40-50 m. The FS photos of sites 3 and 6 show wooded pads with no water in view. No site on open ground within 50 m, so not lakefront.

SEASON conflict (manual group, not overwritten): stored 05-08 to 09-26 matches the FS 'Seasons of Use May 8 - September 26', but recreation.gov's rate table sells a 'First-come, First-served Season' 2026-09-09 to 10-19 (2027: Non-Peak to 10-25) and its notice says the campground is 'closed and gates typically locked November 1st through May 1st' with water off in October. Reviewer may want closes ~10-19 per the trust-rec.gov rule.
PHONE missing: rec.gov facility phone and FS page give the LaCroix Ranger District, (218) 666-0020. Suggest 218-666-0020.
Pin 48.16947,-92.49113 is the FS point near sites 019/023/024, about 90 m from the middle of the loops; no move. Websites confirmed.

Status: FS 'Site Partially Closed / Closed-No fees or services', the ordinary end of season. The post-wildfire order closes NFS land north along the Echo Trail but lists no developed campground, and the press release says the Echo Trail is open. Nothing written.
